name: omitly-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server exposing Omitly's local, verifiable PDF redaction to AI agents. Redaction runs on-device — documents are never uploaded.

scripts.test: tsc && node --test --test-skip-pattern="(v2-produced file|v2 verdict that disagrees|DECISION_CHANNELS is the shared vectors|surfaces decisionChannel only when verified)" "dist/**/*.test.js"
scripts.mcpb:prep: node mcpb/scripts/copy-wasm.mjs && cp LICENSE mcpb/LICENSE && npm --prefix mcpb ci
scripts.mcpb:pack: npm run mcpb:prep && npm run mcpb:validate && mkdir -p dist-mcpb && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb@2.1.2 pack mcpb dist-mcpb/omitly-leak-check.mcpb
